name: 2-Block Littlestone Dimension / $k$-Block Littlestone Dimension (affine)
details: For every fixed integer $k>2$, the complete-block comparison gives $\mathrm B_k\le\frac{k}{2}\mathrm B_2+(k-1)$, equivalently the displayed affine lower bound.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Proposition prop:block-littlestone-round-order.
proof: The general relation $\mathrm B_\ell\le(\ell/k)\mathrm B_k+(\ell-1)$, instantiated with the smaller block size $k=2$ and $\ell>2$, gives $\mathrm B_2\ge\frac{2}{\ell}\mathrm B_\ell-\frac{2(\ell-1)}{\ell}$. Renaming $\ell$ as the fixed parameter $k$ gives the stated bound.
witness_verification: Fix construction width b=2 and any query block size k>2 in the branching batch-tree class. As height n grows, the exact values are B_2=2n and B_k=2. Thus B_2/(1+B_k)=2n/3 tends to infinity, excluding every reverse affine bound even when its constants depend on fixed k. See survey Corollary prop:branching-batch-separations and the database-owned value proofs.
